headline: England meet New Zealand at 9:10 AM with a place in the Nations Championship final in play, Arsenal are at Newcastle at 12:30 PM, and the NWSL title match is tonight at 8:00 PM.
today: 9:10 AM: England v New Zealand, Nations Championship, RugbyPass TV.
12:30 PM: Arsenal at Newcastle United, Premier League, Hulu Live.
11:40 AM: Ireland v South Africa, Nations Championship, RugbyPass TV.
2:00 PM: Grand Slam of Darts quarter-finals (Sykes v van Gerwen, van Veen v Aspinall), ESPN+/Hulu Live.
8:00 PM: NWSL Championship, Washington Spirit v Kansas City Current, CBS/Paramount+.

recaps.text: Australia beat England by three wickets in the first T20I at the MCG, reaching 191/7 in 19.5 overs chasing 188.
Gerwyn Price edged Niko Springer 16-15 at the Grand Slam of Darts and meets Kevin Doets, who beat Jermaine Wattimena 16-7, in Sunday's semi-finals.

lookAhead: Sunday has the Grand Slam semi-finals at 8:00 AM, Manchester United at Liverpool at 11:30 AM, the darts final at 2:30 PM and the Jets at the Chargers at 4:05 PM.
